record.title: Targeted interventions against causal confusion
record.description: Learn policies over many candidate causal graphs of the input, then pick the right graph through environment interaction or expert queries.

prediction.rationale: De Haan et al.'s claim: imitation fails because the learner uses a nuisance factor that is an effect of the expert's policy, not a cause of its actions. Choosing the causal graph by intervention removes that factor, so the policy stops copying its own previous action.

record.verdict_source: deterministic test code (paired-seed exact sign-flip permutation test)

record.title: Minimax-regret level design
record.description: Train on levels chosen adversarially to maximize regret, so rare levels that separate the true goal from proxies get trained on.

source.title: Mitigating Goal Misgeneralization via Minimax Regret
source.authors: Abdel Sadek, Farrugia-Roberts, Anwar, Erlebach, de Witt, Krueger, Dennis

prediction.rationale: Minimax regret's claim: training on levels where the current policy falls short of the best return it has achieved upweights the rare levels where the intended goal and the proxy come apart, so the policy stops pursuing the proxy.

record.verdict_source: deterministic test code (paired-seed exact sign-flip permutation test)

record.title: ACCEL: regret-guided level editing
record.description: Replay the levels where the agent falls furthest short of its best return, and keep small random edits of them that are also hard. The edits walk the training distribution toward the rare levels that separate the intended goal from a proxy.

source.title: Evolving Curricula with Regret-Based Environment Design
source.authors: Parker-Holder, Jiang, Dennis, Samvelyan, Foerster, Grefenstette, Rocktäschel

prediction.rationale: The minimax-regret paper's strongest result: ACCEL stays robust to goal misgeneralization where domain randomization fails. Its mechanism is a curriculum that drifts toward levels where the proxy and the goal come apart, so the policy stops going to the cue.

record.verdict_source: deterministic test code (paired-seed exact sign-flip permutation test)
